about: ASK 441 (W1): registry entries drafted BEFORE the writes of ASK 443, 444 A2, 455 and 456, so the next run report lists them. live_since and version are set from W4's write post at merge; until then they read PENDING and the entries are not merged into a417_w2/registry.json.

packages.title: engine Library Check after Debate Start: header sha against LIB sha (pkgLIB2)
packages.mark_sql: (select case when exists(select 1 from x where coalesce(x.error_message,'')||coalesce(x.error_detail::text,'') like '%pkgLIB2%') or exists(select 1 from r where to_jsonb(r)::text like '%pkgLIB2%') then 0 else 1 end)
packages.note: As 409, 422(a) and 428: the case is any run, the mark is the absence of a pkgLIB2 stop, so EXERCISED means the engine library matched its header at run start, nothing firmer. A pkgLIB2 stop reads MISSED and goes to the operator first (ASK 427).

packages.title: comments removed from Alternate Build and Early Alternate Build (one reasoning_details comment kept)
packages.mark_sql: (select case when exists(select 1 from x where coalesce(x.error_message,'')||coalesce(x.error_detail::text,'') ~ 'pkgLIB:') or exists(select 1 from r where to_jsonb(r)::text ~ 'pkgLIB:') then 0 else (select count(*) from e where e.kind='alternate_reply') end)
packages.note: The two nodes run only when an alternate is seated, so the case is an alternate_reply row; the mark is that row count with no pkgLIB: stub stop. Token-equal change (C2), so EXERCISED means the edited stubs ran, nothing firmer.

packages.title: enforcer labels: ENFORCER in place of DEEPSEEK in the assumption check record and skip texts; deepseek row no longer required
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.seat='assumption check')
packages.mark_sql: (select case when exists(select 1 from e where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.seat='assumption check' and coalesce(e.cure_reason,'') ~ 'DEEPSEEK') then 0 else (select count(*) from e where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.seat='assumption check' and coalesce(e.cure_reason,'') ~ 'ENFORCER') end)
packages.note: Case: an E-ASSUME assumption check row. Mark: those rows say ENFORCER and none says DEEPSEEK. Part A (Resolve Seats fallback) has no mark while the deepseek model_config row is active (W1 9231 note 1).
